fluff.overview: The Tortoise II is a mixed-technology assault battle armor developed by StarCorps Industries for the Republic of the Sphere. Introduced in 3134, the quad-chassis design blends Inner Sphere and Clan components into an unorthodox weapons platform built around a hybrid wheel-and-leg motive system. The suit carries its armament in a distinctive split configuration, with a modular turret mount and a detachable weapon pack that can be jettisoned to improve mobility. Earning the nickname "Wheelbarrow" during its troubled prototype phase, the Tortoise II emerged as a durable if unconventional addition to the Republic's experimental battle armor program.
fluff.capabilities: The LRM configuration equips the Tortoise II's modular turret with a Clan-manufactured LRM 4 launcher carrying seven rounds of ammunition, paired with the standard ER medium pulse laser in the detachable weapon pack. This loadout gives the suit indirect fire capability unique among Tortoise II configurations, allowing troopers to engage targets beyond direct line of sight when supported by spotters. The two-ton quad chassis limits ground speed to a walking pace under full load, though jettisoning the detachable pack doubles mobility at the cost of the pulse laser. Protected by 350 kilograms of Clan improved stealth armor, the LRM variant is well-suited to providing sustained fire support from covered positions. The stealth signature helps compensate for the suit's lack of speed, making it difficult for enemies to locate and engage before the trooper can deliver multiple salvos of long-range missiles.
fluff.deployment: Five-trooper Points of LRM-equipped Tortoise IIs provided Clan-structured Republic formations with dedicated indirect fire assets. The Point organization concentrated enough long-range missile fire to suppress enemy positions or soften targets before faster elements closed to engagement range.
fluff.history:
StarCorps Industries began developing the Tortoise at their Thetford Proving Grounds facility on Terra under the direction of Dr. Stephen Vance. The original prototype replaced its rear legs with wheels, an experimental approach intended to improve stability and load-bearing capacity for an assault-class suit. The unusual motive system earned the prototype the unflattering nickname "Wheelbarrow" and proved extraordinarily expensive to refine. StarCorps spent years and considerable resources attempting to reconcile the hybrid wheel-and-leg locomotion before Dr. Vance's redesign, incorporating myomer-enhanced shock absorbers on the rear wheels, finally produced a workable platform.

The StarCorps board approved procurement of Clan-grade components from Arc-Royal MechWorks, allowing the rechristened Tortoise II to incorporate advanced weapons systems drawn from designs like the Cuchulainn and Fenrir II. A sole field trial conducted in 3134 demonstrated the suit's durability and considerable firepower, with opposition forces caught off guard by the punishment the prototype could absorb and deliver. The trial concluded shortly before the activation of Fortress Republic severed Terra's communications with the rest of the Inner Sphere. The Tortoise II's ultimate fate behind the Fortress walls remained unknown to outside observers, though Republic officials had expressed confidence that the design would anchor future battle armor doctrine within the Republic Armed Forces.
